about: Canonical card data (CONSISTENCY-001a, CSA-03). Loaded by godot/scripts/core/cards.gd (CardDB). Edit here, not in code; see docs/architecture-v2/CANONICAL_SOURCE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

FORTRESS_ICEPICK.name: FORTRESS Icepick
FORTRESS_ICEPICK.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. First break each turn free; then {pick.break_cost} BW per break.

TUMBLER_ICEPICK.name: TUMBLER Icepick
TUMBLER_ICEPICK.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.
TUMBLER_ICEPICK.flavor: The combination is merely a suggestion.

VOID_ICEPICK.name: VOID Icepick
VOID_ICEPICK.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.
VOID_ICEPICK.flavor: Stare into the abyss. Make it blink.
VOID_ICEPICK.approved_text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. Whenever you break a subroutine, reveal one remaining concealed subroutine on that ICE.
VOID_ICEPICK.divergence: Approved reveal after each successful break by this Icepick, next concealed subroutine in resolution order on the same ICE; no effect if none remain. Runtime reconciliation pending.

BASIC_EXTRACTOR.name: Basic Extractor
BASIC_EXTRACTOR.text: End of your turn: extract {extract} CRED.

PULP_SHIELD.name: PULP Shield
PULP_SHIELD.flavor: Your safety is our primary concern.

PROBE.name: PROBE
PROBE.text: Choose one: Target ICE: −{modes.weaken.amount} STR this encounter. OR Target VOID: Reveal all hidden subroutines. Costs {escalation} additional BW for each PROBE already played on the target ICE this turn.
PROBE.flavor: The deeper you probe, the costlier it gets.

GHOST_SIGNAL.name: GHOST SIGNAL
GHOST_SIGNAL.text: The first TRACE added in the next Corporation Response becomes 0. BURNED.
GHOST_SIGNAL.flavor: Please disregard the absence of evidence.

BATTERING_RAM.name: BATTERING RAM
BATTERING_RAM.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. First break each turn free; then {pick.break_cost} BW per break.

JACKHAMMER.name: JACKHAMMER
JACKHAMMER.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. First break each turn free; then {pick.break_cost} BW.

PASSKEY.name: PASSKEY
PASSKEY.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.

RAINBOW_TABLE.name: RAINBOW TABLE
RAINBOW_TABLE.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW for up to 2 subroutines on the same ICE.

TASER.name: TASER
TASER.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.
TASER.approved_text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. If TASER breaks at least one subroutine on an ICE, disable that ICE's PARTING SHOT.
TASER.divergence: Approved encounter-local PARTING SHOT suppression after any successful TASER subroutine break on that ICE. Ordinary Corporation Responses unaffected; repeated breaks do not stack. Engine reconciliation pending.

STUN_BATON.name: STUN BATON
STUN_BATON.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. Each break: +{pick.shield_per_break} SHIELD.

SKELETON_KEY.name: SKELETON KEY
SKELETON_KEY.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. Works on FORTRESS, TUMBLER and VOID.

DATA_SIPHON.name: DATA SIPHON
DATA_SIPHON.text: End of your turn: extract {extract} CRED.

SKIMMER.name: SKIMMER
SKIMMER.text: When installed: extract {extract_on_install} CRED. End of your turn: extract {extract} CRED.

SURGE_PROTECTOR.name: SURGE PROTECTOR
SURGE_PROTECTOR.text: Start of each of your turns: +{shield} SHIELD.

FAILSAFE.name: FAILSAFE
FAILSAFE.text: The first time each encounter you would gain CORTEX, prevent all of it.

JAMMER.name: JAMMER
JAMMER.text: In the next Corporation Response, the first {subroutines} TRACE subroutines add 0 TRACE (their ▸ effects don't happen).

BURST.name: BURST
BURST.text: Gain {bw_gain} BW. Each time you play this card this encounter, it costs {cost_step} more BW for the rest of the encounter.

PROXY_CHAIN.name: PROXY CHAIN
PROXY_CHAIN.text: Whenever you would gain TRACE during a Corporation Response, gain {trace_less} less.

SPAM_FILTER.name: SPAM FILTER
SPAM_FILTER.text: The first Bloatware the corporation would INSERT each encounter goes to your discard pile instead.

UNINSTALLER.name: UNINSTALLER
UNINSTALLER.text: Choose a Bloatware in your hand: it's BURNED. Draw {draw}.

FIELD_KIT.name: FIELD KIT
FIELD_KIT.text: Search your draw pile for a PROGRAM and put it in your hand.

TOOLBELT.name: TOOLBELT
TOOLBELT.text: Your first Icepick boost each turn costs 0 BW.

BALANCED_LOAD.name: BALANCED LOAD
BALANCED_LOAD.text: +{shield} SHIELD. Target ICE: −{str_down} STR this encounter.

ADAPTER.name: ADAPTER
ADAPTER.text: Your Icepicks can break subroutines on any ICE type, for +{break_extra} BW per break.

READY_STANCE.name: READY STANCE
READY_STANCE.text: On the first turn of each encounter, draw {draw} extra card.

MULTITOOL.name: MULTITOOL
MULTITOOL.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.

HUSH.name: HUSH
HUSH.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW.

BORROWED_CREDENTIALS.name: BORROWED CREDENTIALS
BORROWED_CREDENTIALS.text: Choose a FORTRESS or VOID. This turn, HUSH can break its subroutines using normal Strength requirements, boosts and break costs.

SLOW_DRIP.name: SLOW DRIP
SLOW_DRIP.text: End of your turn: extract {extract} CRED. If you have gained no TRACE this encounter, extract {extract_quiet} instead.

SMOKESCREEN.name: SMOKESCREEN
SMOKESCREEN.text: +{shield} SHIELD. The first TRACE you gain during the next Corporation Response is reduced by {trace_less}.

PATIENCE.name: PATIENCE
PATIENCE.text: +4 SHIELD if you've gained no TRACE this encounter; otherwise +2 SHIELD.

DECOY_SIGNAL.name: DECOY SIGNAL
DECOY_SIGNAL.text: Until the end of your turn, VOID reactive abilities do nothing.

SILENT_PARTNER.name: SILENT PARTNER
SILENT_PARTNER.text: End of your turn: extract 2 CRED for each CLOAK card you played this turn.

LONG_GAME.name: LONG GAME
LONG_GAME.text: While your TRACE is under 10, your Extractors extract +2 CRED each.

VANISH.name: VANISH
VANISH.text: During the next Corporation Response, TRACE effects add nothing. BURNED.

SIDE_CHANNEL.name: SIDE CHANNEL
SIDE_CHANNEL.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. Any ICE type.

BLACKOUT.name: BLACKOUT
BLACKOUT.text: Skip the next Corporation Response. BURNED.

SLEDGE.name: SLEDGE
SLEDGE.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. First break each turn free; then {pick.break_cost} BW per break. Each break: +{pick.trace_per_break} TRACE.

BRUTE_FORCE.name: BRUTE FORCE
BRUTE_FORCE.text: Break {breaker.n} subroutine on any ICE with STR {breaker.max_str} or less. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

OVERLOAD.name: OVERLOAD
OVERLOAD.text: Target ICE: −{str_down} STR this encounter. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

FEEDBACK.name: FEEDBACK
FEEDBACK.text: Target ICE: −{str_down} STR this encounter for every {per_trace} TRACE you have.

SHATTER.name: SHATTER
SHATTER.text: This turn, SLEDGE can break subroutines on target ICE of any type. At the end of your turn, SLEDGE drops to STR 0 for the rest of the encounter. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

SMASH_AND_GRAB.name: SMASH & GRAB
SMASH_AND_GRAB.text: End turn: extract {extract} CRED; +{extract_trace} TRACE if below {extract_trace_below}. 1 BW: uninstall this; CACHE another card in hand until the end of your next turn.

SMASH.name: SMASH
SMASH.text: Target FORTRESS: −4 STR this encounter. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

PAIN_TOLERANCE.name: PAIN TOLERANCE
PAIN_TOLERANCE.text: Start of your turn: if your TRACE is 20 or more, +2 SHIELD.

BERSERK.name: BERSERK
BERSERK.text: While your TRACE is 20 or more, your EXPLOIT SCRIPTS cost 1 less BW (minimum 0).

WRECKING_BALL.name: WRECKING BALL
WRECKING_BALL.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW, +{pick.trace_per_break} TRACE.

CHAINSAW.name: CHAINSAW
CHAINSAW.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW, +{pick.trace_per_break} TRACE.

FLASHPOINT.name: FLASHPOINT
FLASHPOINT.text: Break 1 subroutine on every ICE with STR 3 or less. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

NO_WITNESSES.name: NO WITNESSES
NO_WITNESSES.text: If your TRACE is 30 or more, set it to 10. BURNED.

STINGER.name: STINGER
STINGER.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost: {pick.boost_cost} BW → +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break: {pick.break_cost} BW. Each break also INFECTs {pick.rot_per_break} ROT on that ICE.

RUNTIME_ERROR.name: RUNTIME ERROR
RUNTIME_ERROR.text: Break {breaker.n} subroutine on any ICE with {breaker.min_virus} or more virus counters. (+{trace_cost} TRACE)

REPLICATOR.name: REPLICATOR
REPLICATOR.text: Start of your turn: on every ICE with virus counters, add {counters} counter of each strain already on it.

OUTBREAK.name: OUTBREAK
OUTBREAK.text: Double the counters of every strain on target ICE.

SCRAMBLER.name: SCRAMBLER
SCRAMBLER.text: INFECT {infect.SCRAMBLE} SCRAMBLE. (Each SCRAMBLE: this ICE's PULP subroutines deal 1 less.)

BLINDFOLD.name: BLINDFOLD
BLINDFOLD.text: INFECT {infect.BLIND} BLIND. (Each BLIND: this ICE's TRACE subroutines add 1 less.)

LEECHWARE.name: LEECHWARE
LEECHWARE.text: INFECT {infect.LEECH} LEECH. (Each LEECH: extract 1 CRED at the start of your turn.)

QUARANTINE.name: QUARANTINE
QUARANTINE.text: +1 SHIELD for each virus counter on target ICE (maximum +6).

WORMHOLE.name: WORMHOLE
WORMHOLE.text: INFECT {infect.WORM} WORM and {infect.ROT} ROT. (WORM: on your turn, remove 2 WORM from an ICE to break 1 of its subroutines. Each ROT: −1 STR.)

COCKTAIL.name: COCKTAIL
COCKTAIL.text: INFECT 1 of each strain (ROT, SCRAMBLE, BLIND, LEECH, WORM).

INCUBATOR.name: INCUBATOR
INCUBATOR.text: Whenever a PURGE removes virus counters from an ICE, INFECT 2 ROT on that ICE afterward.

PANDEMIC.name: PANDEMIC
PANDEMIC.text: Copy all virus counters on target ICE onto every other ICE.

HOST_TAKEOVER.name: HOST TAKEOVER
HOST_TAKEOVER.text: Break {breaker.n} subroutines on target ICE with {breaker.min_virus} or more virus counters.

SPAM.name: SPAM
SPAM.text: Can't be played normally. Pay 1 BW to clear it: it disappears for good.

TRACER.name: TRACER
TRACER.text: Can't be played. If TRACER is in your hand at the end of your turn: +3 TRACE.

FORCE_REBOOT.name: FORCE REBOOT
FORCE_REBOOT.text: Shuffle your discard pile into your draw pile (this is a REBOOT). BURNED.

SHORT_LOOP.name: SHORT LOOP
SHORT_LOOP.text: Whenever you REBOOT: gain 1 BW and draw 2.

GARBAGE_COLLECT.name: GARBAGE COLLECT
GARBAGE_COLLECT.text: BURN 1 other card in your hand. Draw 1.

TAIL_CALL.name: TAIL CALL
TAIL_CALL.text: Put a SCRIPT from your discard pile into your hand.

PIVOT.name: PIVOT
PIVOT.text: Target ICE −{zeroed_reduction} STR this encounter. If target ICE STR is 0, break one of the target ICE subroutines for no cost.

KILL_CHAIN.name: KILL CHAIN
KILL_CHAIN.text: Whenever you get a CHAIN bonus, draw 1 (maximum 2 per turn).

SCALPEL.name: SCALPEL
SCALPEL.text: STR {pick.str}. Boost {pick.boost_cost} BW: +{pick.boost_amt} STR. Break {pick.break_cost} BW. OVERKILL {pick.overkill}: break costs 0 BW.

STACK_SMASH.name: STACK SMASH
STACK_SMASH.text: Target ICE −1 STR per EXPLOIT played this turn, including this.
STACK_SMASH.approved_text: Each ICE −1 STR per EXPLOIT played this turn, including itself.
STACK_SMASH.divergence: Existing runtime targets one ICE. Approved revision affects each ICE in the current encounter without target selection; retain current runtime-facing target and text until atomic engine/data reconciliation. See CARD-REVIEW-001.

NULL_POINTER.name: NULL POINTER
NULL_POINTER.text: Target ICE at 0 STR: break {breaker.n} subroutines, DEADLOCKs included. Normal limits apply. BURNED.

KNOCKOUT.name: KNOCKOUT
KNOCKOUT.text: Target ICE −{zeroed_reduction} STR. ZEROED: break 1 subroutine (normal limits).

SECOND_WIND.name: SECOND WIND
SECOND_WIND.text: Target ICE −{zeroed_reduction} STR. ZEROED: gain 1 BW.

CULL.name: CULL
CULL.text: Remove up to 3 virus counters from target ICE; +2 SHIELD each.

HARVEST.name: HARVEST
HARVEST.text: Remove all LEECH from target ICE; extract 3 CRED each.

CLEAN_BUILD.name: CLEAN BUILD
CLEAN_BUILD.text: Your COMPILED cards cost 1 less BW.

MINIMALIST.name: MINIMALIST
MINIMALIST.text: While GHOST, your first break each turn costs 0 BW.

ZERO_FOOTPRINT.name: ZERO FOOTPRINT
ZERO_FOOTPRINT.text: Reduce TRACE by cards below cap, maximum 10. BURNED.

REACTIVE_ARMOUR.name: REACTIVE ARMOUR
REACTIVE_ARMOUR.text: Whenever you play a card, gain {shield} SHIELD.

COUNTERINTELLIGENCE.name: COUNTERINTELLIGENCE
COUNTERINTELLIGENCE.text: Whenever you play a CLOAK, reduce TRACE by {trace_down}.
COUNTERINTELLIGENCE.flavor: The less they know, the more you control.

OVERCLOCK.name: OVERCLOCK
OVERCLOCK.text: Upon playing your fourth card each turn, draw {draw} cards and gain {bw_gain} BW.

FEEDBACK_LOOP.name: FEEDBACK LOOP
FEEDBACK_LOOP.text: Whenever you ZERO an ICE for the first time, gain {bw_gain} BW.
FEEDBACK_LOOP.flavor: Nothing goes to waste. Not even failure.

SALVAGE.name: SALVAGE
SALVAGE.text: First DEADLOCK broken each turn: return a selected discarded card to hand.

ADAPTIVE_DEFENCE.name: ADAPTIVE DEFENCE
ADAPTIVE_DEFENCE.text: Whenever you install a PROGRAM, gain {shield} SHIELD.
ADAPTIVE_DEFENCE.flavor: Security improves with every unauthorized installation.

FOLLOW_THROUGH.name: FOLLOW THROUGH
FOLLOW_THROUGH.text: Target ICE −{str_down} STR, additional −{bonus} if previous card played was EXPLOIT.

ESCALATION.name: ESCALATION
ESCALATION.text: Target ICE −{str_per} STR per EXPLOIT played this turn including itself.

AFTERBURN.name: AFTERBURN
AFTERBURN.text: Gain {shield} SHIELD if at least three other cards played this turn.
AFTERBURN.flavor: Efficiency is a matter of perspective.

REPRISE.name: REPRISE
REPRISE.text: ECHO the previous SCRIPT played this turn.
REPRISE.flavor: Repetition is the mother of exploitation.

KEYLOGGER.name: KEYLOGGER
KEYLOGGER.text: Start of your turn: choose an ICE; it gets −1 STR this encounter.

STASH.name: STASH
STASH.text: CACHE up to 2 cards in your hand.

QUANTUM_CORE.name: QUANTUM CORE
QUANTUM_CORE.text: Start of your turn: gain 1 BW.

HOT_SWAP.name: HOT SWAP
HOT_SWAP.text: Unload one of your PROGRAMS, then install a PROGRAM from your hand for 0 BW.

JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.name: JACK OF ALL TRADES
JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.text: If you have a FORTRESS, a TUMBLER and a VOID Icepick installed: on every ICE, break 1 subroutine for 0 BW using your matching Icepick. Each Icepick still needs enough STR.

uplink.about: CSA-04g: the card side of the Black Market Uplink contract (UplinkContract). Services and the Clinic are Core Rules §8.3; stock rules are UPLINK-SPEC-001; card prices are UPL-008; CAP prices are on the CAP records.

SUBDERMAL_PLATING.name: SUBDERMAL PLATING
SUBDERMAL_PLATING.text: At the start of each Node, gain 6 SHIELD that lasts the whole Node (not just one turn).

OVERCLOCKED_BUS.name: OVERCLOCKED BUS
OVERCLOCKED_BUS.text: +1 BW on the first turn of each encounter.

SPARE_SOCKET.name: SPARE SOCKET
SPARE_SOCKET.text: +1 CAP slot. Gain a random common CAP at the start of each corporation.

MONEY_MULE.name: MONEY MULE
MONEY_MULE.text: Your Extractors extract 25% more CRED (rounded up).

SIGNAL_BOOSTER.name: SIGNAL BOOSTER
SIGNAL_BOOSTER.text: You can see what's inside SIGNAL UNCLEAR Nodes before choosing them.

SCRAMBLED_ID.name: SCRAMBLED ID
SCRAMBLED_ID.text: The first TRACE strike in each corporation has no penalty (TRACE still drops to 20).

BURNOUT_CHIP.name: BURNOUT CHIP
BURNOUT_CHIP.drawback: Whenever you take PULP damage, take 2 more.

KILLSWITCH.name: KILLSWITCH
KILLSWITCH.text: Once per Node, if damage would drop your VITAE to 0, it drops to 1 instead.

RECYCLER.name: RECYCLER
RECYCLER.text: Whenever a card is BURNED, gain 1 BW (once per turn).

CHAOS_ENGINE.name: CHAOS ENGINE
CHAOS_ENGINE.text: Whenever you play your 4th card in a turn, draw 1.

LUCKY_STRIKE.name: LUCKY STRIKE
LUCKY_STRIKE.text: Card rewards offer 4 cards instead of 3.

FIRST_CONTACT.name: FIRST CONTACT
FIRST_CONTACT.text: The first ICE you meet in each Node gets −2 STR.

SLEEPER_AGENT.name: SLEEPER AGENT
SLEEPER_AGENT.text: At the start of each corporation, add a random rare card to your deck.

LONG_MEMORY.name: LONG MEMORY
LONG_MEMORY.drawback: Your first card each turn costs 1 more BW.

DEAD_MANS_POCKET.name: DEAD MAN'S POCKET
DEAD_MANS_POCKET.text: Deferred: its HOLD enhancement is inactive under HAND-CLEANUP-001.

SIXTH_SENSE.name: SIXTH SENSE
SIXTH_SENSE.text: Draw 1 extra card on the first turn of each encounter.

FIELD_MEDIC.name: FIELD MEDIC
FIELD_MEDIC.text: At every SAFEHOUSE, heal 5 extra VITAE.

PATCH_CABLE.name: PATCH CABLE
PATCH_CABLE.text: Whenever you apply a PATCHWORK, heal 4 VITAE.

MINIMAL_INSTALL.name: MINIMAL INSTALL
MINIMAL_INSTALL.text: At the start of each ICE Node, if your FOOTPRINT is in the GHOST band, +1 AMP.

DEDUPLICATOR.name: DEDUPLICATOR
DEDUPLICATOR.text: FUSE works on any card type, not only SCRIPTs.

ONE_TRICK.name: ONE-TRICK
ONE_TRICK.drawback: Your deck can't grow past the corporation's cap minus 4 (HALCYON 18, IRONWATCH 25, LUCIDA 31): at that size, the card reward screen offers only DECOMPILE or skip.

HEARTH_KEY.name: HEARTH KEY
HEARTH_KEY.text: At the start of each encounter, every FORTRESS gets −1 STR.

VOICE_MIMIC.name: VOICE MIMIC
VOICE_MIMIC.text: Once per encounter, the first TRACE subroutine that would resolve fails.

AD_BLOCKER.name: AD BLOCKER
AD_BLOCKER.text: Bloatware the corporation INSERTs always goes to your discard pile, never your hand or draw pile.

KEVLAR_WEAVE.name: KEVLAR WEAVE
KEVLAR_WEAVE.text: PULP from ICE subroutines deals 1 less to you (minimum 0).

BADGE_CLONE.name: BADGE CLONE
BADGE_CLONE.text: At the start of each encounter, every VOID gets −1 STR.

DASHCAM_FEED.name: DASHCAM FEED
DASHCAM_FEED.text: Whenever you BREACH a layer, heal 3 VITAE.

LUCID_DREAM.name: LUCID DREAM
LUCID_DREAM.text: CORTEX can't reduce your DRAW below 3.

MEMORY_BACKUP.name: MEMORY BACKUP
MEMORY_BACKUP.text: Whenever an ICE makes you FORGET, draw 1 card.

NEURAL_FIREWALL.name: NEURAL FIREWALL
NEURAL_FIREWALL.text: The first CORTEX you would gain each encounter is prevented.

ghostware_about: CSA-07 (designer 2026-11-28: 'We need a canonical database for ghostware'): one record per Ghostware. Effects: REDLINE_UPGRADES_EVENTS_ESCAPE.md §2, Deck Synergy §9.3, ICE Corp 2 §8, ICE Corp 3 §9; prices P5-008 (100 CRED, 75 with a drawback; corporation sets are payload-only, ORIGINs never offered). ORIGIN text lives in CardDB.RUSTLERS.
